episodes.title: I Was Raised in a Cult Led by My Own Father
episodes.description:
What happens when you leave a religious cult? Kelsie Loy shares how she escaped an isolated life to redefine her own future.

Kelsie grew up inside Desert Rose, a strict community in the Utah desert led by her father. After his passing when she was nine, she had to navigate the difficult transition into the outside world. This conversation covers the reality of religious trauma, the process of rebuilding an identity from scratch, and how she eventually became a successful entrepreneur and author.

Her story serves as a powerful reminder that we are not defined by our upbringing. Whether you are interested in overcoming adversity or curious about how to find independence after leaving a cult, this episode provides a roadmap for defining success on your own terms. We discuss the importance of personal growth and how to build a life aligned with your true desires.

Subscribe for more inspiring stories of resilience and personal growth, and let us know in the comments: what is one choice you made that completely changed your life path?
